title: AION 2 Gathering: Skills and Node Routes
description: Start AION 2 gathering with region-aware unlock guidance, understand experience and specialization, choose useful materials and plan efficient node routes.
summary: Check Global's displayed unlock and node requirements, separate gathering from crafting, and choose materials for an actual recipe. Use KR/TW tutorials as labeled references rather than fixed Global rules.
quickAnswer: Try an accessible node and check Essence Extraction for gathering progress. A Global player reports gathering around level 10–11; the level-45 unlock rule comes from KR and is not verified for Global.

topic.alt: Aion2T community map showing only Aria herb markers in Verteron
topic.caption: Aion2T's English Global-mode interface, checked October 3, 2026. Herbs → Aria is a filtering example; it does not verify in-game access, live spawns or material yield.

workflow.title: Test a material before building a farming loop
workflow.caption: A small test separates recipe demand, actual node access and the value of repeating a route.

steps.label: Name the missing ingredient
steps.description: Copy the exact material and quantity from your current recipe or upgrade screen.

steps.label: Test one accessible node
steps.description: Read its requirement, watch the success/failure gauges and check the resulting material and proficiency.

steps.label: Filter a compact cluster
steps.description: Match your faction's zone and show only the intended material; treat markers as possible stops.

steps.label: Compare one timed run
steps.description: Record useful yield, failed attempts and travel time before investing points or buying the batch.
